Subfrost F-Droid Repository

Official F-Droid repository for Subfrost applications. This repository contains Subtun and other Subfrost Android apps.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://f-droid.subfrost.io/fdroid/repo
